items.t: Sudden loss of drive power from battery software (recall)
items.job: Battery management software update under recall 24V-372

items.t: 12-volt battery low or critical warning, car won't start
items.job: Software update, 12-volt battery test and replacement if weak
items.note: Often fixed under warranty with software and a battery charge. A new 12-volt battery is the higher end of this range.

items.t: High-voltage battery malfunction message
items.job: Replace high-voltage battery pack
items.note: Normally covered by the high-voltage battery warranty. Price is RepairPal's estimate for a sister EQE model.

items.t: Faulty 80-amp fuses can cut power (recall)
items.job: Replace main fuse boxes under recall 24V-115

items.t: Wrong fuse box installed during earlier repair (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace main fuse boxes under recall 25V-255

items.t: Drivetrain software can cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Drivetrain software update under recall 23V-405

items.t: No warning for high-voltage battery faults (recall)
items.job: Battery monitoring software update under recall 23V-309

items.t: Sudden automatic braking with nothing ahead
items.job: Driver-assist software update and sensor calibration

items.t: Rear seat belt buckle bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure rear buckle bolts under recall 23V-464

items.t: Side curtain airbag can be cut by roof brackets (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace window airbags and brackets under recall 24V-960

items.t: Wrong pedestrian warning sound when reversing (recall)
items.job: Pedestrian alert software update under recall 25V-366

items.t: Hands-off steering detection may not work (recall)
items.job: Hand detection control unit software update under recall 22V-189

items.t: Stability control software can shut off (recall)
items.job: Stability control software update under recall 23V-360

items.t: Rearview camera image may not appear (recall)
items.job: MBUX software update under recall 22V-493

items.t: Rear turn signals, hazards and reverse lights may fail (recall)
items.job: Rear signal software update under recall 22V-167

items.t: Tow ring can come loose from the bumper (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace tow ring assembly under recall 22V-467

items.t: Loose ground and heater wiring connections (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair ground and heater connections under recall 22V-112

items.t: MBUX screens go black, freeze or lose sound
items.job: MBUX and head unit software update
items.note: Usually free, often done over the air.

items.t: Flush door handle hard to open or won't lock
items.job: Replace door handle bearing bracket or handle assembly
items.note: The low end is the bracket from the bulletin; a full handle costs more.

items.t: Grinding or creaking from the steering column
items.job: Steering column switch module noise repair per bulletin

items.t: Power steering control unit fault
items.job: Power steering control unit software update

items.t: Air suspension sagging or faults
items.job: Air suspension software update and leak check
items.note: If an air spring has failed, replacing it costs much more.

items.t: A/C blows warm from failed expansion valve
items.job: Replace A/C expansion valve and recharge
items.note: Price is RepairPal's estimate for the sister EQE SUV.

items.t: Trunk won't open or opens by itself
items.job: Trunk lock microswitch repair or software change per bulletin

items.t: Parking or daytime running light warning
items.job: Lighting control unit software update
items.note: If the headlight assembly itself is faulty, replacement costs much more.

items.t: Front seat creaks or feels loose
items.job: Seat back or height adjuster repair per bulletin

items.t: Squeak when reversing slowly
items.job: Drive unit seal repair per bulletin

items.t: Gear whine from the electric drive unit
items.job: Drive control unit software update

items.t: Sunroof reopens after closing
items.job: Sunroof control software update

items.t: Tire blowout on large wheels
items.job: Replace one tire, mount and balance
items.note: A full set of 20–22 inch tires runs about $1,200–$2,000 installed.
